title: checkout-service: API latency p99 exceeded 3s on checkout service

hypotheses.title: Increased load on the checkout service
hypotheses.rationale: A sudden surge in user traffic or requests to the checkout service could overwhelm its resources, leading to increased latency. This is especially relevant given the impact on payments.

hypotheses.title: Database query performance degradation
hypotheses.rationale: Slow database queries within the checkout service could be a bottleneck. This could be due to inefficient queries, database locking, or increased data volume.

hypotheses.title: Dependency service degradation (e.g., payment gateway)
hypotheses.rationale: The checkout service relies on other services, such as payment gateways. If one of these dependencies is experiencing performance issues, it could impact the checkout service's latency.

hypotheses.title: Recent code deployment introduced a performance regression
hypotheses.rationale: A recent code change to the checkout service might have introduced a performance bottleneck, such as inefficient algorithms or resource leaks.
